app.name: aqua
app.one_liner: Declarative CLI version manager written in Go that supports lazy install, registry-based tool management, and continuous updates via Renovate.

screens.name: Tool Management Dashboard
screens.purpose: Display configured CLI tools, their versions, and installation status with options to update or switch versions.

rust_commands.name: install_tool
rust_commands.purpose: Lazily install a CLI tool from the registry based on declared configuration.

rust_commands.name: switch_version
rust_commands.purpose: Switch the active version of a CLI tool for the current project context.

rust_commands.name: sync_with_renovate
rust_commands.purpose: Check for available updates via Renovate integration and propose version bumps.

mvp_plan: week 1: Build project-scoped version switching logic
week 1: Implement core lazy install mechanism for registry-based tools
week 1: Integrate basic Renovate update detection
acceptance_tests: Given a new version is available via Renovate, when syncing, the system proposes an update without breaking existing installations.
Given a project with an aqua configuration, when the user runs a declared CLI tool, then it is installed lazily and executed.
Given two projects with different versions of the same tool, when switching between them, the correct version is active in each context.
